container.name: projects
container.query: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.abbreviation AS displayName, c.description, c.proponentName AS proponent, c.proponentId, c.sector, c.projectSubType, (IS_NUMBER(c.legislationYear) ? c.legislationYear : null) AS legislationYear, c.projectState AS status, c.region, c.eagleId AS legacyEagleId, c.sourceSystem, c.centroid, c.read, c.isPublished, c.projectType AS type, c.currentPhaseName.name AS currentPhaseName, c.currentPhaseName._id AS currentPhaseNameId, c.eacDecision.name AS eacDecision, c.eacDecision._id AS eacDecisionId, c.CEAAInvolvement._id AS ceaaInvolvementId, c.decisionDate, c.dateUpdated, ToString(c.vis) AS vis, c.name AS nameTokens, ((IS_STRING(c.sector) AND LENGTH(TRIM(c.sector)) > 0 ? c.sector : (IS_STRING(c.projectSubType) ? c.projectSubType : '')) || ' ' || (IS_STRING(c.projectState) ? c.projectState : '') || ' ' || (IS_STRING(c.region) ? c.region : '') || ' ' || (IS_STRING(c.projectType) ? c.projectType : '') || ' ' || (IS_STRING(c.currentPhaseName.name) ? c.currentPhaseName.name : '') || ' ' || (IS_STRING(c.eacDecision.name) ? c.eacDecision.name : '')) AS searchLabels, (IS_ARRAY(c.tags) ? ARRAY(SELECT VALUE t FROM t IN c.tags WHERE IS_STRING(t)) : null) AS tags, (IS_ARRAY(c.tags) ? ARRAY(SELECT VALUE t FROM t IN c.tags WHERE IS_STRING(t)) : null) AS tagsTokens, c._ts FROM c WHERE c._ts >= @HighWaterMark ORDER BY c._ts
